hook.text: Cars, heating, cooking, and factories are all switching from fossil fuels to electricity. The grid becomes the backbone.

buildup.text: Electrification shifts energy demand from oil and gas to the power grid. The grid must grow massively.

discovery.text: Countries that electrify fastest reduce oil import dependency. Energy security moves from pipelines to power lines.

twist.text: Electrification concentrates risk on the grid. A grid failure or cyberattack blacks out everything at once.

climax.text: Electrification solves one vulnerability and creates another. The grid becomes the single most critical infrastructure.

punchline.text: Electrify everything. Then protect the plug.

quiz.question: What new risk does electrification create?
options: Electricity is more expensive than any fossil fuel
Grid failures or cyberattacks can black out everything
Electric devices cannot function in cold weather
